title: Tags
markdown:
A playbook tag can be used to define role-based access control (RBAC) for playbooks. To configure RBAC, analysts must create playbook tags and associate them with both playbooks and user groups in Respond. Members of a Respond user group can execute playbooks only if the assigned tags match those of the user group. For more information, see [Create Playbook Tags](https://techdocs.cyware.com/co/en/create-playbook-tags.html).

You can perform the following actions in this module:

*   **Retrieve Tags**: Fetch the list of tags.
    
*   **Retrieve Tag Details**: Fetch the details of a specific tag.
